info.title: Home Center 0.60 Parental Internet Policy Change API
info.description: Authenticated same-origin parental Desired State lifecycle: source-identity-free UI plan, exact-plan credential re-auth, and explicit confirmation. The server derives content-addressed local rule-source identity from user-visible rule facts. Confirmation commits protected Desired State only and never invokes DNS/proxy enforcement or grants infrastructure/publication authority.

post.description: The browser supplies only user-visible rule facts. rule_source_id/version/SHA-256 are derived server-side and cannot be selected by the client.

200.description: Exact parent-authorized change plan. Desired State write and enforcement are not yet authorized.

503.description: Household or verified base state unavailable

post.description: Issues one short-lived single-use grant only after current credentials are verified and the exact plan/current authority/state are revalidated. Passwords are never persisted or returned.

409.description: Plan already committed, stale or otherwise not re-auth eligible

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Must equal the exact plan_id being confirmed.

parameters.name: X-Home-Center-Step-Up
parameters.description: Required for a new Desired State commit. May be omitted only for an already committed exact idempotent receipt replay, which performs no new mutation.

200.description: Protected parental Desired State committed/read back, or the exact already-committed receipt replayed. Enforcement remains unverified and reconciliation-required.

403.description: Parent authority or step-up grant rejected

503.description: Verified base, durable state or read-back unavailable
